summary: Mingteng International Corp., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering closed June 10, 2026. It sold 501,834 Class A ordinary shares at $2.00/share and 629,170 pre-funded warrants at $1.99995 each, which were immediately exercised. Gross proceeds were ~$2.26M; net proceeds for working capital. FT Global Capital served as placement agent with a 7% fee. The offering was conducted under an effective shelf registration statement. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
